description: LROC WAC polar movie frames (every eighth, 400 m browse images) against the 2 m horizon masks: is the ground at the site sunlit? Only photos where the terrain decides (some of the Sun clears the lowest point of the site's skyline). Expected sunlit: the mask gives the whole Sun and the ground would be at least twice the sunlit threshold in full sunlight (Lommel-Seeliger over the 30 m facets in the pixel); expected in shadow: no Sun.
